FINAL: India

hits.text: 8 March – India beat New Zealand in the final match and win the 2026 Men's T20 World Cup in cricket.
The 2026 Men's T20 World Cup held in India and Sri Lanka begins.
ICC Men's T20 World Cup in India and Sri Lanka
5 July – Australia wins the 2026 Women's T20 World Cup after defeating England in the final.
June 12 – July 5 – The 2026 Women's T20 World Cup is held in England and Wales, and is won by Australia.
